name: Barbell Wrist Curl
summary: An isolation exercise that targets the forearm flexors by curling a barbell upward using only wrist flexion.

setup: Kneel beside a flat bench holding a barbell with a shoulder-width supinated (palms up) grip.
Rest the backs of your forearms flat across the bench so that your wrists and hands hang just off the edge.
steps: Lower the barbell toward the floor by extending your wrists under control.
Optionally allow the bar to roll slightly down into your fingers at the bottom for an increased stretch.
Re-grip tightly and flex your wrists upward as high as possible, raising the bar through full flexion.
Pause briefly at the top to contract the forearm flexors before lowering smoothly into the next repetition.
instructions.breathing: Exhale as you curl the weight up into wrist flexion, and inhale as you lower the barbell.
cues: Keep forearms glued to the bench
Curl through the wrists, not the elbows

common_faults.fault: Lifting the forearms off the bench to assist the curl with the biceps.
common_faults.correction: Keep your forearms firmly pressed into the bench pad throughout the entire set.

common_faults.fault: Using excessively heavy weight that restricts the active range of motion.
common_faults.correction: Select a lighter load that allows for a deep wrist extension and complete wrist flexion.

precautions: Avoid letting the barbell slip out of your fingers at the bottom of the stretch.
